table.name: city
table.purpose: Catalog of world cities with their population, the country they belong to, and the administrative district (state/province/region) within that country. Each row is one city. This is the classic MySQL 'world' sample database city table.

CountryCode.name: CountryCode
CountryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country the city belongs to (e.g. CHN, IND, USA, PHL). References country.Code (many cities per country).

District.name: District
District.description: Name of the first-level administrative subdivision (state, province, region) the city is located in, e.g. 'California', 'Central Luzon', 'Nagano', 'England'. Free text, not a code.

ID.name: ID
ID.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for each city (1..4079). Referenced by country.Capital, which stores the city ID of a country's capital. The join to country.IndepYear is spurious (coincidental numeric overlap).

Name.name: Name
Name.description: City name (e.g. 'Lubao', 'Matsumoto'). Not unique — different countries/districts share names like 'Cambridge' or 'Córdoba'.

Population.name: Population
Population.description: Number of inhabitants of the city (persons). Ranges from 42 to 10,500,000; median ~167,000.

table.name: country
table.purpose: Reference table of world countries (one row per country, 239 rows), with demographic, geographic, economic and political attributes. Primary key Code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3) is referenced by city and countrylanguage. This is the classic MySQL 'world' sample database, with data circa 1998-2001 (heads of state like George W. Bush, Jacques Chirac).

Capital.name: capital_city_id
Capital.description: ID of the country's capital city; references city.ID (one-to-one). Null for territories without a capital (e.g. British Indian Ocean Territory).

Code.name: country_code_iso3
Code.description: Primary key: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g. ABW, GBR, THA). Referenced by city.CountryCode and countrylanguage.CountryCode.

Code2.name: country_code_iso2
Code2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 two-letter country code (e.g. AD, DM, IS).

Continent.name: continent
Continent.description: Continent the country belongs to; one of 7 values (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Oceania, Antarctica).

GNP.name: gnp_usd_millions
GNP.description: Gross National Product, in millions of US dollars (max 8,510,700 for the US). 0.0 for territories without an economy.

GNPOld.name: gnp_old_usd_millions
GNPOld.description: Gross National Product for an earlier reference year, in millions of US dollars; null for ~25% of countries. Exact reference year is not documented in the data, so an alternative reading (e.g. an older snapshot or revised figure) cannot be ruled out.

GovernmentForm.name: government_form
GovernmentForm.description: Form of government, e.g. Republic, Constitutional Monarchy, Federal Republic, Dependent Territory of the UK.

HeadOfState.name: head_of_state
HeadOfState.description: Name of the head of state (as of the data snapshot, ~1998-2001), e.g. Elisabeth II, George W. Bush, Vladimir Putin.

IndepYear.name: independence_year
IndepYear.description: Year the country became independent; null for dependent territories. Negative values (min -1523) indicate BCE dates (e.g. ancient states).

LifeExpectancy.name: life_expectancy_years
LifeExpectancy.description: Average life expectancy in years (range 37.2-83.5); null for some territories.

LocalName.name: local_name
LocalName.description: Country name in its local language(s) or endonym (e.g. 'Lao', 'Al-Jaza'ir/Algérie', 'Uzbekiston').

Population.name: population
Population.description: Country population in persons (max ~1.28 billion, China); 0 for uninhabited territories.

Region.name: region
Region.description: Geographic sub-region within the continent (25 values, e.g. Caribbean, Eastern Africa, Middle East, Southeast Asia).

SurfaceArea.name: surface_area_sq_km
SurfaceArea.description: Country land area in square kilometers (max 17,075,400 for Russia; min 0.4 for Vatican City).

table.name: countrylanguage
table.purpose: Lists languages spoken in each country, with the share of the population speaking each language and whether it is an official language. One row = one (country, language) pair. This is the classic MySQL 'world' sample database countrylanguage table.

CountryCode.name: CountryCode
CountryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country where the language is spoken; references country.Code (many languages per country).

IsOfficial.name: IsOfficial
IsOfficial.description: Whether the language is an official language of the country; 'T' = true (official), 'F' = false (not official).

Language.name: Language
Language.description: Name of the language spoken in the country (e.g. English, Arabic, Urdu).

Percentage.name: Percentage
Percentage.description: Percentage (0-100) of the country's population that speaks the language; 0.0 appears for languages with negligible/unknown share.
